description: Contact verification, lead validation: email and phone check in one call. One call to vet a contact: email_check (format, MX, throwaway, role address), phone_check (valid, type, country) and email_security for the email's domain (SPF, DKIM, DMARC grade). Send email and/or phone. Nothing is stored or logged. Price: $0.006 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
